title: An efficient probabilistic hardware architecture for diffusion-like models
task: Design all-transistor probabilistic hardware for diffusion-like models with extreme energy efficiency
key_results: System-level analysis predicts ~10,000× energy reduction vs. GPUs on benchmark; all-transistor architecture implements stochastic computing at hardware level for denoising models
comments: Compelling efficiency claims but lack of experimental prototype and comparison to other specialized architectures (tensor cores, neuromorphic chips)—practical viability unproven.

title: Optical spiking neural networks via rogue-wave statistics
task: Implement optical spiking neural networks using rogue-wave statistics for nonlinear threshold activation
key_results: Achieves 82.45% accuracy (BreastMNIST) and 96.67% (Olivetti Faces) competitive with digital baselines; sparse spatial spikes emerge from rogue-wave thresholding; phase-engineered caustics concentrate energy deterministically; physics-informed digital twin optimizes phase masks
comments: Creative exploitation of extreme-wave phenomena for neuromorphic computing novel but scalability to large datasets and comparison to low-power photonic baselines unclear.

title: An atlas of primate insular cortex reveals a signal-processing strategy in von Economo neurons
task: Characterize cell types and signal-processing mechanisms in primate anterior insular cortex
key_results: Identified 78 cell types in macaque AIC including two VEN subtypes (DSG2-expressing VEN-L and POC5-expressing VEN-S); discovered dendritic geometry-based action potential reshaping that enhances somatic responsiveness to deep-layer inputs
comments: The integration of transcriptomics with electrophysiology and morphology provides mechanistic insight, though the functional relevance of the identified VEN signal-processing strategy to interoceptive-exteroceptive integration remains to be tested in behaving animals.
